author: humble_flor
body: Nicks superburgers in Fullerton 👌🏼 we've been going for years and the burgers have to be the best ones in the world so delicious 😋 they have a 2 pack right now - 2 burgers for $17 (used to be 15). Comes with a big set of fries and two drinks too!

author: dp6s
body: Wow. Legit burger spot! Thank you!
